sources.title: Bilateral Reference for High-Resolution Dichotomous Image Segmentation
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce a novel bilateral reference framework (BiRefNet) for high-resolution dichotomous image segmen-tation (DIS). It comprises two essential components: the localization module (LM) and the reconstruction module (RM) with our proposed bilateral reference (BiRef).
